page.overview:
Who is Jazz Hooves?

Jazz Hooves is a female Earth pony and supporting character in the My Little Pony Generation 5 special My Little Pony: Make Your Mark and subsequent Generation 5 media. She is a resident of the seaside Earth pony town of Maretime Bay, working as a manicurist/pedicurist at Pipp Petals' Mane Melody beauty salon.

Jazz Hooves' name is similar to the G1 Earth pony Jazzie, the G2 Earth pony Jazzy, the G3 Earth pony Jazz Matazz, Jazz Hoof, and the Transformers character Jazz. She sometimes appears without ears in My Little Pony: Make Your Mark; animator Karmyn "SnookumsGal" Chretien explained on Discord that "Concept art had a drawing of Jazz with a big poofy head of hair that covered her ears. When translated to 3D, they couldn't keep that much hair poof, so her ears initially clipped through her hair. Clients/Directors/etc didn't like seeing her ears clip through her hair and because in her concept art/model sheet she didn't have ears drawn, they decided 'remove her ears from the rig to match concept'. This decision was finalised sometime after the first special which is why they disappeared shortly after something like Chapter 2, Ep 1 or 2."

In the hour-long special My Little Pony: Make Your Mark, Jazz Hooves appears as a stylist employed at Pipp Petals' beauty salon Mane Melody. She first appears giving a hooficure to a ticklish Hitch Trailblazer, and she performs Everything is Gonna Be Okay alongside Pipp and Rocky Riff.

In the Make Your Mark Chapter 2 episode Izzy Does It, Jazz observes as Pipp struggles to come up with a new song. In Growing Pains, she and her fellow Earth ponies deal with their out-of-control plant magic after Hitch places restrictions on its use. In Portrait of a Princess, Jazz welcomes Queen Haven to the Mane Melody salon and gives her a hooficure. In Ali-Conned, she helps Pipp attract more attention on social media when her viewership numbers start to dwindle. In Hoof Done It?, she is briefly seen when Misty ducks into Mane Melody in an attempt to hide from Zipp Storm and later watches as Sunny Starscout dashes through town trying to gather ponies together in an attempt to find her missing lantern.
